advisory.finding: The AST gate only flags json.dumps that lexically appears within a stdout-sink call's argument expression; a helper that returns json.dumps(...) and is then written to stdout is not detected, so the gate's 'a future emitter cannot silently reintroduce a bare big-int' guarantee does not hold for the (common) helper-return / intermediate-variable pattern.
scenarios: A new CLI emitter builds its JSON in a helper returning json.dumps(...) and writes the result to stdout; the gate passes green while a 19-digit ns timestamp goes out as a bare number
